items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: They call him Blue. Blue, Walter Blue. Yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: Broke that from blowing, shot him up in the air. In his throat huh? Died that night. They call him Blue. Blue, Walter Blue. Yeah, yeah.
His son plays at Lutton's now. Little Blue is at Lutton's. The old folks on down at Almonaster and Murray.
